en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground two children in traditional Alpine-style clothing stand on a riverside path with a wooden railing. Across the river are grand multi‑story buildings and a bridge. Behind the city rises a steep hill topped with fortifications and towers. The river flows through the middle of the scene. The printed caption in red at the top right reads "Graz. Mur, Schlossberg."
